title: India Wins Record 6th ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup
summary: India U-19 team captained by Ayush Mhatre beats England by 100 runs in Harare to claim India's 6th U-19 World Cup title.

blocks.content: India defeated England by 100 runs at Harare to win their **record 6th ICC Under-19 World Cup title** (Captain: Ayush Mhatre; Player of Series: Vaibhav Suryavanshi).

provenance.sourceTitle: India Wins Record 6th ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup
